## Expected Behavior
Interfaces, like `ContextPropagator` are not linked.

For example, `ContextPropogator` in `internal/headers.go` should have a line like `// Exposed as: [go.temporal.io/sdk/workflow.ContextPropagator]` in its docstring


## Actual Behavior
No linkage in docstring
